standards.intendedUse: Applicable-rule conformance reference for deterministic JSON canonicalization.
standards.caveat: LRPv1 uses a deliberately restricted SAFEINT value profile; registry inclusion does not claim RFC certification.

standards.intendedUse: Reference for SHA-256 behavior and known-answer testing.
standards.caveat: Registry inclusion does not claim CAVP or FIPS 140 validation. NIST has announced a future revision of FIPS 180-4.

standards.intendedUse: Capability and gap crosswalk for artifact provenance concepts.
standards.caveat: Registry inclusion does not claim any SLSA build level or attestation compliance.

standards.intendedUse: External quality-model reference for software and ICT product characteristics.
standards.caveat: Crosswalk use is not certification or an ISO conformity assessment.

standards.designation: ISO/IEC 25023:2016 — Measurement of system and software product quality
standards.intendedUse: Reference for quantitative software product quality measures used with ISO/IEC 25010.
standards.caveat: Crosswalk use is not certification or an ISO conformity assessment.

standards.intendedUse: Reference framework for planning and conducting quality evaluation.
standards.caveat: The standard supplies an evaluation framework rather than a universal pass/fail result.

standards.intendedUse: External reference for structured software testing processes, documentation, and techniques.
standards.caveat: Registry inclusion records an evaluation target only; no series-wide conformity claim is made.

standards.designation: NIST SP 800-218 — Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) v1.1
standards.intendedUse: Practice crosswalk for secure software development lifecycle controls.
standards.caveat: A crosswalk is not a security audit, certification, or proof of vulnerability absence.

standards.intendedUse: Primary external process reference for defining, applying, and evaluating software/system measurement information.
standards.caveat: Process alignment does not establish construct, criterion, predictive, or cross-domain validity.

standards.designation: ISO 5725-1:2023 — Accuracy (trueness and precision) of measurement methods and results — Part 1
standards.intendedUse: Conditional reference for repeatability, reproducibility, trueness, and precision studies where the method and data satisfy the standard's applicability assumptions.
standards.caveat: Not universally applicable to IMI; ISO 5725-1:2023 concerns controlled measurement methods yielding a continuous single-value result.
